caption: : Eval PPL. under different Sub-Dim Numbers settings.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the evaluation Perplexity Loss (Eval PPL) for two models, Transformer and MoHD, as the number of sub-dimensions varies. The x-axis, labeled “Numbers of Sub-Dims,” is linear and spans from 1632 to 256, with tick marks at intervals of 64. The y-axis, labeled “Eval PPL,” is linear and ranges from 9.5 to 12.5. The Transformer model is represented by a solid brown line with square markers, which remains constant at an Eval PPL value of 11.5 across all sub-dimension values. The MoHD model is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, which starts at an Eval PPL of approximately 10.35 at 1632 sub-dimensions, rises slightly to about 10.55 at 64 sub-dimensions, and then remains relatively flat, ending at approximately 10.55 at 256 sub-dimensions.
